AccountId.description: ID of the AWS account the stack is deployed to. Terraform refuses to run against any other account.

AwsProviderVersion.description: Version constraint for the `hashicorp/aws` Terraform provider.

Dns.description: DNS and TLS for the ALB. `Enable` points `<Environment>.oslo.systems` (created by the `dns` template) at the ALB. `EnableHttps` serves HTTPS on that domain and redirects all HTTP requests to HTTPS; when disabled, the ALB serves plain HTTP instead. `EnableIPv6` makes the ALB reachable over IPv6.

Environment.description: Environment name (for example `dev` or `prod`), applied as the `Environment` tag on every resource in the stack.

IamForCicd.description: Deprecated: use the `cicd-common` template instead. `AssumableCdRole` lets the AWS provider assume the environment's CI/CD role, so you can run Terraform locally with the same permissions as the pipeline.

IncludeLockFile.description: Include a Terraform dependency lock file (`.terraform.lock.hcl`) that pins provider versions.

Internal.description: Make the ALB internal, so it is only reachable from inside the VPC. If false, the ALB is internet-facing.

Name.description: Load balancer name, used to name the ALB and related resources.

Region.description: AWS region the stack's resources are created in.

S3Backend.description: Store Terraform state in the environment's S3 state bucket, with state locking. Requires the `remote-state` template to have created the bucket; does not create it. If disabled, state is stored locally.

StackName.description: Name of the Terraform stack, normally the name of the stack's folder in the IaC repository. Determines where the stack's state is stored.

Team.description: Team name, applied as the `Team` tag on every resource in the stack.

TerraformVersion.description: Terraform version constraint, set as `required_version` for the stack.

Terragrunt.description: Generate a `terragrunt.hcl` so the stack can be run with Terragrunt instead of plain Terraform. This is an experimental feature and should not be used in production.
